items.content_text: io.github.jamal-wia:paginator-core-js 10.0.3 发布, Shared core types of the Paginator pagination library: PageState, PaginatorUiState, PagingCache base interfaces, bookmarks, exceptions, logger, interweave, prefetch options, and reactive cache plumbing. Consumed by paginator-offset, paginator-cursor, and the UI binding modules. Pick this module if you are implementing your own paginator strategy on top of the shared abstractions.

items.title: io.github.jamal-wia:paginator-offset-js 10.0.3 发布, Offset / page-number pagination for the Paginator pagination library. Provides Paginator, MutablePaginator, PagingCore, PaginatorPrefetchController, the offset DSL, eviction strategies, and the offset serialization layer. Builds on paginator-core. Pick this module for classic page-based feeds (page 1, 2, 3 …); for cursor / GraphQL-connection-style feeds use paginator-cursor instead.

Provides idiomatic bindings between CursorPaginatorPrefetchController and LazyListState / LazyGridState / LazyStaggeredGridState — auto-pagination on scroll without manual snapshotFlow wiring. items.title: io.github.jamal-wia:paginator-compose-core-iosarm64 10.0.3 发布, Compose Multiplatform UI utilities shared between paginator-compose-offset and paginator-compose-cursor. Contains the scroll-position preservation primitives (ScrollSnapshot data classes, ScrollSnapshotRegistry, internal save/restore composables) that back the `preserveScroll = true` parameter on BindToLazyList / BindToLazyGrid / BindToLazyStaggeredGrid, plus the shared scroll-binder core (BindScrollInternal) and PrefetchErrorChannel. Depends only on paginator-core (for the ScrollWindow index-remapping math); independent of paginator-offset and paginator-cursor.
